decision.reason: The only evidence is one changelog line [ev-fff1292f7fe3]. It says lambda-promtail no longer evaluates an empty string for drop_labels. It does not name a PROMTAIL_CONFIG environment variable, and it does not say how drop_labels is configured (env var, flag or config key). It also does not say which setups were affected before the fix, for example an unset or empty drop_labels. The proposed env-var condition is therefore unsupported, and it may also be too broad. Settling the exposure needs the linked PR #11074 or commit 94169a0, showing which input carries drop_labels and which values triggered the old behaviour.
